_doc: Pieces of the integration kit (data/interiors/kit_footprints.json) that are drawn by an EXISTING furniture piece until the kit is baked (I3, wave 5b): an oven is a fireplace, a tub is a rug. Room JSON carries kit ids only (no stand_in field); PieceCatalog resolves baked kit manifest > furniture.json > this table > a labelled box, and reports every stand-in it used (towns_interiors.stand_ins_listed, tools/towns/interiors/validate.py --stand-ins). Footprint and layer of a stand-in piece come from the KIT table, so the room does not change when the art lands. The 14 core rooms use the first 16 (design_towns.md 4.3); counter_pine is the counter of every shop band (table_long_pine until the counter is baked); counter_end, counter_hatch and sign_bracket have no stand-in: nothing is drawn while their art is missing.
